reviews.text:
I really like this product. It is easy to use and looks very nice on the skin.
Overall, I'm happy with this product and would buy it again. I recommend it if you want simple and pretty makeup.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢件產品。容易使用，搽喺皮膚上好靚。整體嚟講，我對呢件產品好滿意，會再次回購。如果你想化簡單又靚嘅妝，我會推薦。

reviews.text: "It smells so good like "pudding" and the consistency is great. Because it has a built-in "aplicator," you don't need to stick your fingers in and make it unhygenic. The pendant is also super cute. It would have been nice if there were extra pallets to put in there instead of taking from the big product to put it into the small one.
reviews.zh: 「聞落好似「布甸」，質地好好。因為佢內置咗「上妝棒」，唔使用手掂到，咁就唔會整到污糟。吊飾都好得意。如果可以有多幾個補充裝可以裝入去，而唔係要由大裝嗰度鏟出嚟放入細裝嗰度就好。

reviews.text: Definitely overhyped. It always pills up no matter what I do (i dont have this issue with any of my other branded lippies), looks patchy, the applicator is horrible, and overall not really good. i wouldnt recommend this nor would i repurchase.
reviews.zh: 絕對係過譽。無論我做咩都會起粒粒（我其他品牌嘅唇彩都冇呢個問題），上色斑斑駁駁，個上妝棒好差，整體嚟講真係唔好。我唔會推薦，亦唔會回購。

reviews.text: Love the cute packaging have yet to try formula but just right off the bat super convenient with the built-in applicator
reviews.zh: 鍾意佢得意嘅包裝，仲未試過個配方，但一拎出嚟就覺得內置上妝棒好方便。

reviews.text: I don’t think I like this one.. the fact that it’s liquid-y inside makes me worry that it might leak in my handbag. It tastes bitter and the fragrance is too strong for me. Colour is ok
reviews.zh: 我覺得我唔鍾意呢款…入面係液態呢點令我擔心會喺手袋度漏。味道苦，香水味對我嚟講太濃。顏色就OK。

reviews.text: A light application gives a natural look, while a heavier application is adorable. The packaging is also super cute.
reviews.zh: 薄薄搽一層有自然嘅效果，厚搽嘅話好可愛。包裝都超得意。

reviews.text: bought this due to me loving cute packaging and it's pretty good as a lip tint! i don't know how it'll work on the cheeks since i havent tried it but on the lips its pretty good! however, the applicator is pretty small and it was hard to use sometimes
reviews.zh: 因為鍾意得意嘅包裝所以買咗，做唇釉幾好用！我未試過搽喺面頰，唔知效果如何，但搽喺嘴嘅效果幾好！不過個上妝棒幾細，有時比較難用。

reviews.text: cute and fun packaging! it is slightly messy and soft, so i recommend having q-tips to help clean up any leaking or mess. cute color, but it turned out more pink than mauve. compared to another jelly pot that i own, it is a lot more soft and opaque.
reviews.zh: 得意又有趣嘅包裝！質感有少少凌亂又偏軟身，所以建議大家準備定棉花棒，方便清理漏出嚟或者整到周圍都係嘅情況。顏色得意，不過出嚟效果偏粉紅多過偏玫瑰木色。對比我另一個 jelly pot，呢款明顯更軟同更遮色。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
